name: load-more
title: Load More
description: A self-replacing pagination trigger. Click a button or scroll a sentinel into view; htmx appends the next page and swaps in a fresh trigger via hx-swap="outerHTML". When the server omits the trigger, the chain ends. The click mode is a real <button> so it works without JavaScript.

files.content: defmodule ShadcnHtmx.Components.LoadMore do @moduledoc """ Load More — shadcn-htmx, htmx v4 + Tailwind v4 for Phoenix. A self-replacing pagination trigger. It appends the next page and swaps a fresh trigger into its place (`hx-swap="outerHTML"`); when the server omits the trigger from its response, the chain ends. Two modes: * `trigger="click"` — a real ` <% end %> """ end end
